app.name: Alarm clock
app.summary: Two alarms you set on the screen itself, with a popup, a sound and entities for Home Assistant.
app.input_player_hint: Optional: a speaker of Home Assistant that plays a sound when an alarm goes off. Leave empty for none.
app.part_sound_hint: The alarm's own sound, on a screen with a speaker.
app.setting_snooze_hint: Show a Snooze key when an alarm goes off. Off: only Stop.
app.setting_ring_minutes_hint: How long an alarm rings when nobody stops it.
app.setting_sound_hint: Ring on the screen's own speaker.
app.setting_media_hint: What the media player plays: an address (https://...) or a media-source id of Home Assistant. Empty: the alarm's own beeps.
app.setting_media_volume_hint: The media player's volume for the alarm. 0 leaves it as it is.
app.setting_test_hint: Makes the screen ring now, as an alarm does.
